import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int SIZE = 202;
    static final int INF_VAL = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] flow_flow = new int[SIZE][SIZE];
    static int[][] capacity_flow = new int[SIZE][SIZE];
    static int[] prev_node = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] queue_arr = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] dist_arr = new int[SIZE];

    static int max_flow(int total_nodes, int src, int dst) {
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(prev_node, -1);
            dist_arr[src] = INF_VAL;
            int f = 0, r = 0;
            queue_arr[r++] = src;
            while (f < r && prev_node[dst] < 0) {
                int cur = queue_arr[f++];
                for (int node = 0; node < total_nodes; ++node) {
                    if (prev_node[node] < 0) {
                        int res_cap = capacity_flow[cur][node] - flow_flow[cur][node];
                        if (res_cap > 0) {
                            prev_node[queue_arr[r++] = node] = cur;
                            dist_arr[node] = Math.min(dist_arr[cur], res_cap);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (prev_node[dst] < 0) break;
            int aug = dist_arr[dst];
            for (int nd = dst; nd != src; nd = prev_node[nd]) {
                flow_flow[prev_node[nd]][nd] += aug;
                flow_flow[nd][prev_node[nd]] -= aug;
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int nd = 0; nd < total_nodes; ++nd)
            total += flow_flow[src][nd];
        return total;
    }

    static char[][] board_in = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] board_out = new char[11][11];
    static int zombie_i, zombie_j;
    static int[] move_dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[] move_dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[][] dist_table = new int[101][101];
    static int grid_size, time_limit;
    static List<Integer> lst_row = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> lst_col = new ArrayList<>();

    static void bfs_compute(int si, int sj, int[] result_dist, boolean check_flag) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        result_dist[si * grid_size + sj] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{si, sj});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            int idx = i * grid_size + j;
            int d_val = result_dist[idx];
            if (check_flag) {
                if (dist_table[zombie_i * grid_size + zombie_j][idx] <= d_val || time_limit <= d_val) {
                    if (dist_table[zombie_i * grid_size + zombie_j][idx] < d_val || time_limit < d_val)
                        result_dist[idx] = INF_VAL + 1;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int ni = i + move_dx[k], nj = j + move_dy[k];
                if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni == grid_size || nj == grid_size) continue;
                char ch = board_out[ni][nj];
                if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') continue;
                int nidx = ni * grid_size + nj;
                if (result_dist[nidx] != INF_VAL) continue;
                result_dist[nidx] = d_val + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
            }
        }
    }

    static void prepare_graph() {
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                char c = board_out[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    lst_row.add(i);
                    lst_col.add(j);
                    int idx = i * grid_size + j;
                    capacity_flow[idx + 2 + grid_size * grid_size][1] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        int z_idx = zombie_i * grid_size + zombie_j;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                char c = board_in[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int idx = i * grid_size + j;
                    capacity_flow[0][idx + 2] = c - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < lst_row.size(); ++k) {
                        int ri = lst_row.get(k), ci = lst_col.get(k);
                        int q_idx = ri * grid_size + ci;
                        if (dist_table[idx][q_idx] < INF_VAL)
                            capacity_flow[idx + 2][q_idx + 2 + grid_size * grid_size] = INF_VAL;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        grid_size = sc.nextInt();
        time_limit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_table[i], INF_VAL);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; i++) {
            board_in[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; i++) {
            board_out[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        zombie_i = -1;
        zombie_j = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; j++) {
                if (board_in[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zombie_i = i;
                    zombie_j = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs_compute(zombie_i, zombie_j, dist_table[zombie_i * grid_size + zombie_j], false);
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; j++) {
                if (board_in[i][j] >= '1' && board_in[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs_compute(i, j, dist_table[i * grid_size + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        prepare_graph();
        System.out.println(max_flow(2 + grid_size * grid_size + grid_size * grid_size, 0, 1));
    }
}
